name: Riana
source:
A wizard who has lived for over 300 years. She kidnaps the protagonist to use as food for her familiar, all for the sake of her apprentice, Miu.
She originally lived in the same town as the protagonist, but now lives alone with Miu in a deep forest whose location is unknown.
She is self-centered and treats the protagonist as if he were a mere tool.
